run_train_faiss_index: run the training pipeline to build a FAISS IVF index from a dataset with configurable index key
run_add_vectors_to_index: run the add pipeline to populate a trained FAISS index with database vectors in batches
run_search_faiss_index: run search evaluation on a FAISS index with autotune or manual search parameters and recall metrics
eval_search_setting: eval a FAISS index search setting to measure precision recall and ms per query against ground truth
unwind_index_ivf: unwind a FAISS index chain to extract the underlying IndexIVF and optional vector transform
